title: PvPItems++
description: Adds uranium-based PvP gear and tools with high damage and custom crafting — perfect for combat-heavy survival or modded servers.
body:
⚔️ PvPItems++

PvPItems++ is a combat-focused mod for Minecraft 1.21.5+ built on NeoForge.
It introduces uranium-based gear to spice up your PvP and survival experience!

💎 Features
  • 🟢 Uranium Sword – massive damage with glowing green energy
  • 🛡️ Uranium Armor – high durability with radiation aesthetics
  • 🔧 Crafting Recipes – custom recipes using uranium ingots
  • 🎮 Designed for PvP and modded survival servers

🔧 Requirements
  • Minecraft 1.21.5+
  • NeoForge 21.5.75+

📦 Installation
  1. Install NeoForge
  2. Place the pvpitemspp.version.jar in your mods/ folder
  3. Launch the game and enjoy!

📌 Notes
  • Uranium gear is powerful but rare — balance it for your server if needed
  • Works well with other combat or tech mods

🧪 Planned Features
  • Uranium bow & arrow
  • Radioactive effects
  • Custom advancements
